clinicalDetails.clinicalHistory: Patient was involved in a road traffic accident eight months ago resulting in a left tibial condylar fracture and an avulsion ACL tear. Open reduction and internal fixation was performed, followed by four to six weeks of non-weight-bearing and progressive loading.
clinicalDetails.chiefComplaint: left knee pain, difficulty performing functional activities and difficulty walking along with ankle and back pain during prolonged walking

subjectiveAssessments.conclusion: Moderate pain with mild irritability particularly during prolonged walking and standing, relieved with rest

tests.comments: restricted and painful on overpressure, with swelling

objectiveGoals.goalName: Improving stability and single leg stability
Strengthening the quadriceps and functional lower limb musculature

patientAdvice.adviceDetails: Physiotherapy recommended once weekly for four sessions with specific rehabilitation focus areas.
